integrity: An algebraic proof establishes the arbitrary-field structure and arbitrary-prime-power finite-field formula. Direct finite tests corroborate only the specified small configurations.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns labeled algebra endomorphisms of the nonunital free associative algebra truncated after word length two; only composition-square-zero maps, not higher nilpotency orders or conjugacy orbits. Unreduced parameter schemes are not asserted. Independent priority confirmation remains outstanding.
title: Complete rank spectra of square-zero endomorphisms of free two-step nilpotent associative algebras
